highlights.reason_zh: 开源运行时探针把 agent 安全测试推进到真实进程边界，但仍需在隔离环境验证开销和误报。
highlights.reason_en: An open-source runtime probe moves agent security testing to real process boundaries, but overhead and false positives still need isolated validation.

highlights.reason_zh: GPT-6.2 已进入付费用户日常对话入口，系统卡同时说明普通聊天与高风险能力仍有边界。
highlights.reason_en: GPT-6.2 reached paid users in the regular chat surface, while the system card preserves a boundary around higher-risk capabilities.

highlights.reason_zh: File Search 支持按字节读取大文件，直接改变大文档 RAG 的延迟、token 与缓存设计。
highlights.reason_en: Byte-range access in File Search directly changes latency, token and cache design for large-document RAG.

highlights.reason_zh: Apache-2.0 权重和代码让交错多模态检索可以本地复现，但现有成绩仍主要来自发布方。
highlights.reason_en: Apache-2.0 weights and code make interleaved multimodal retrieval locally reproducible, while current results remain mostly publisher-reported.

highlights.reason_zh: RoboTrack 同时开放代码、权重与数据，并用真实机器人验证长时点跟踪；最强配置的非商用限制是关键取舍。
highlights.reason_en: RoboTrack ships code, weights and data with real-robot validation; the strongest configuration’s noncommercial restriction is the key tradeoff.

coverage_zh: 固定入口 36/36 成功并完成阅读；主动覆盖模型与 API、开发工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策、中文材料、小团队与重大综合新闻。RoboTrack 只有日期精度，Sirius、OmniEVIE 与 Tool Retrieval 的性能数据仍主要来自发布方，尚待独立复现。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors succeeded and were read. Active discovery covered models and APIs, developer tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy, Chinese-language sources, small teams and exceptional general news. RoboTrack has date-only precision, while performance claims for Sirius, OmniEVIE and Tool Retrieval remain mainly publisher-reported and await independent reproduction.
